name: Kaze
title: The Phantom Blade
description: A shadow-step master who strikes before the enemy can react. Kaze sacrifices raw power for blinding speed and debilitating poisons, winning battles through attrition and precision rather than brute force.

name: Ryuu
title: The Eternal Flame
description: A warrior of legendary power who channels primal fire through every blow. Ryuu hits harder than anyone alive, trading speed and finesse for sheer devastating output that ends fights fast.

name: Tsubaki
title: The Iron Lotus
description: An iron-willed warrior who outlasts everything thrown at her. Tsubaki's defense borders on the impenetrable — she wins not by dealing damage first, but by still standing when everyone else has fallen.

name: Sora
title: The Stormcaller
description: A conduit for elemental chaos who bends lightning, ice, and storm to her will. Sora's special power is unmatched, capable of erasing opponents with a single fully-charged technique — if she survives long enough to charge it.
